messages.subject: warning message with geno.table
parts:
can any one please help me to solve this problem, I have data for 28 markers and 96 individuals as they are my tutorial data. it is the first time to use rqtl and I need it badly, so reading the manual for genetic map construction and loading my data. I found this warning message when using geno.table function
(In chisq.test(x, p = c(0.5, 0.5)) : Chi-squared approximation may be incorrect)
how can i solve this, please?

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] warning message with geno.table
parts:
You don't have sufficient markers for comparegeno to give useful results, and you can't reasonably omit the first individual from each of 900 pairs when you only have 96 individuals in total.

Regarding the error message, we need to see exactly what code you used, preferably with example data, in order to diagnose the problem.

karl
